== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1774. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3593|David Glasgow]] and [[Ford-28175|Anne Ford]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3593]] is assessed at 92% (proved). The 1774 Catholic index citation names Margt and David Glascow. David/Anne Ford’s same-parish 1777 original independently anchors the adult family after their 1773 marriage.

1774 Margaret→adult Rathdowney David-3593.
